answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the ridge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the dawn of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the zenith re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
